thread:
morgan: Heads-up — saw a customer hit 413s when they POST mixed-dim embeddings in a single request. Logs show our preflight returned 200 but runtime rejected with 413. :thinking_face:

tara: oh interesting. do we have the exact payload?

morgan: pasted the gist in the incident ticket: https://redwood/g/INC-4521. smallish array, two vectors are 1536, rest 512. they said they used SDK v0.9.2.

sam: SDK v0.9.2 should still auto-split by dim. are they using the new `X-Vector-Dim` header?

morgan: no header set. curl they used:

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"open-vector-512","input":[[...512...],[...1536...], ...]}'
```

leo: that explains it — our ingress preflight estimator looks only at byte size when no dim hint is present. if a mixed-dim request crosses per-shard payload limit, runtime fast-fails with 413. we expect SDK to send dims but can't rely on it.

irene: UX problem for users. if SDK didn't send dims, console should detect mixed dims and surface a clear error/suggestion not just 413. maybe suggest `X-Vector-Dim` or point to client-side splitter.

sam: agree. short-term: add telemetry event `embed.ingress.oversize_detected` with tags {has_dim_hint, max_dim, request_bytes, estimated_units}. ops-bot: can you open a perf event?

ops-bot: created PERF-5823 with summary "ingress: add oversize telemetry + hint flag" and assigned to eng-platform.

morgan: for the console: can we show a per-request hint in the request inspector saying "Detected mixed vector dims — consider sending per-vector dim header or use SDK >=0.10 to automatically split"?

leo: yes. suggestion: green UX for resolvable hints and red for fatal runtime rejects. also add sample-curl to fix it.

tara: queuing question: should the router attempt automatic fallback and split at ingress if no dim hint present? pros: smoother customer experience. cons: complexity and potential perf regressions for fastpath and batching.

sam: major concern is latency for small requests — automatic splitting will add CPU and memory copying for each request. but we could gate it behind a feature flag and enable for a tiny % of traffic as a canary.

irene: if we do a canary, the console needs to expose per-tenant flag and a chart: %requests auto-split, split latency delta, error reduction. product wants that before rolling out broad.

leo: ok plan proposal:
1) telemetry event `embed.ingress.oversize_detected` (tags above) — immediate (1 day).
2) console: request inspector hint + sample-curl + link to SDK upgrade doc (3 days).
3) backend flag `ingress.auto_split_mixed_dims` rollout to 0.5% tenants for 2 weeks with metrics (2 weeks).
4) if metrics look good, expand to 10% then 100%.

morgan: what KPIs do we track?

leo: primary: client-visible 413 rate for embeddings. secondary: per-request p50/p95 latency delta when split, CPU per-node increase, ops error rate. also cost per token delta.

sam: add a safety circuit: if node CPU or tail latency exceeds threshold we immediately disable auto-split on that node and route to fast-fail path.

tara: one more UX note: console should not only show hint but allow the user to click "auto-split for my tenant" which toggles the per-tenant flag if they have permission. product likes self-serve.

irene: we need to craft the error message for 413 so it's actionable: currently it's just "payload too large". proposed: "Payload too large for embeddings shard. Detected mixed vector dims. Options: (1) Add `X-Vector-Dim` header per-request, (2) use SDK >=0.10 to auto-split, (3) enable auto-split in Console (link)."

sam: +1. add a minute to evplan to make sure telemetry names align with billing events — we don't want mismatches in cost attribution.

morgan: anyone opposed to the rollout timeline?

leo: thumbs up from runtime side, will send PR for the flag and telemetry schema today.

tara: I'll draft console UI mock and add to Figma, will ping design.

irene: I'll own the error copy and support docs.

morgan: great. can we also add a short runbook snippet for oncall in case auto-split causes unexpected perf regressions? e.g., how to flip flag per-tenant and per-node.

ops-bot: added runbook stub to PERF-5823: "ingress-auto-split-runbook.md".

leo: one last thought: should preflight estimator return a new code like 422 with structured JSON explaining the mismatch (e.g., {"error":"mixed_dims","suggestions":[...]}) instead of relying on 413? that'd be nicer for clients.

sam: 422 makes sense semantically. migration cost: SDKs need to handle it. but we can support both: return 422 when we detect mixed dims at preflight, and still fast-fail 413 at runtime as a safety net.

morgan: ok let's do 422 preflight + improved body, telemetry, console hint, and gated auto-split. I'll follow up with a short RFC summarizing all of this. thanks all. :rocket:
